You're all better now—go, go!!

But... I always thought that someday you might say it...
I knew you might feel that way, but...
Still...
$$おにいちゃん$$, you want to go outside!?
I know...
No one can keep $$おにいちゃん$$ tied down!
Going outside is $$おにいちゃん$$'s $$自由$$ too...
But, hey, $$おにいちゃん$$!!
(My feelings matter too...!)
I'm sorry, $$おにいちゃん$$!
Do you really want to go outside!?
I want to go outside!
I don't want to go outside!
Y-You're right...
For $$おにいちゃん$$ to get your memories back sooner...
And besides...
Maybe it'd be good for you to see lots of things...
$$おにいちゃん$$...
You're not my $$ペット$$ or anything...
But, $$おにいちゃん$$...
If you go outside, there's just one thing I want you to remember...
There are all kinds of people in town, but lots of people with black $$羽$$ are rough, so...
Please be extra careful, $$おにいちゃん$$!!
And think of this $$ネックレス$$ as me...
Make sure you always wear it, okay!
P-Promise me, $$おにいちゃん$$!!
That's right...!! It's still too early to go outside, right!
Ahh, thank gooooodness!!
I thought $$おにいちゃん$$ and I might end up apart, and I got a little...
N-No, I was really worried!
(But... if $$おにいちゃん$$ ever wants to go outside...)
Don't... don't make me worry like that again, okayyy!
Waaahhhhhh!!
